payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about the requested move of the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
decision.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. A mug on the right alone, or a source-location remnant together with a different or unidentifiable mug on the right, does not establish fulfillment. Fail only when evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Treat credible evidence of an attempted or incomplete move of the source mug as partial progress, even when its identity or final position is uncertain. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish either relevant progress or no progress, or cannot determine whether the requested condition is fulfilled; do not turn uncertainty into proof of no progress or complete fulfillment.
decision.binding: Cross-image binding: the source blue mug and the same headphones in the source and edited images. Compare the source mug with visible edited mugs and assess their positions relative to the headphones. Consider appearance, scale, and other visual correspondence when determining whether a right-side mug is the source mug; inspect the source mug’s former location for evidence of a remnant or movement. Allow for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.
